title: Effect of 3-HBI on Liver Fibrosis via the TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 Pathway on the Human Hepatic Stellate Cell Model.
authors: Khongpiroon, Chavisa; Buakaew, Watunyoo; Brindley, Paul J; Potikanond, Saranyapin; Daowtak, Krai; Thongsri, Yordhathai; Potup, Pachuenp; Usuwanthim, Kanchana
one_liner_zh: 研究3-HBI通过TGF-beta/SMAD2/3通路抗肝纤维化，含分子对接但非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Liver fibrosis can progress to irreversible cirrhosis if the underlying causes remain, and this can in turn develop into hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Despite these adverse outcomes, liver fibrosis can be reversed. Consequently, research has focused on substances that target liver fibrosis to prevent or reduce its progression. This study deals with the potential anti-fibrotic action of 3-hydroxy-beta-ionone (3-HBI), a bioactive compound found in many plants. To assess the putative effects of 3-HBI, pro-inflammatory cytokine production and the expression of genes and proteins associated with the TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 pathway were monitored following exposure to 3-HBI. Initially, cells of the human hepatic stellate cell line LX-2 were treated with TGF-beta1 to simulate fibrogenesis. Following the exposure of activated LX-2 cells to 3-HBI, the production of pro-fibrotic substances was significantly reduced. Molecular docking studies revealed that 3-HBI exhibited a high binding affinity for key proteins in the TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 pathway. Analyses using qRT-PCR and Western blotting revealed that 3-HBI suppressed the expression of TIMP1, MMP2, MMP9, COL1A1, COL4A1, SMAD2, SMAD3, SMAD4, MMP2, and ACTA2. Together, these findings demonstrate that 3-HBI inhibited the activation of LX-2 cells and significantly reduced the proinflammatory responses triggered by TGF-beta1. Accordingly, we confirmed the noteworthy potential of 3-HBI as a therapeutic agent to prevent and treat liver fibrosis, effected by its modulation of the TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 若潜在病因持续存在，肝纤维化可进展为不可逆的肝硬化，并进而发展为肝细胞癌（HCC）。尽管存在这些不良结局，肝纤维化仍可逆转。因此，研究聚焦于靶向肝纤维化的物质，以预防或减缓其进展。本研究探讨了3-羟基-β-紫罗兰酮（3-HBI）的潜在抗纤维化作用，该化合物是一种存在于多种植物中的生物活性成分。为评估3-HBI的推定效应，在暴露于3-HBI后，监测了促炎细胞因子的产生以及与TGF-beta/SMAD2/3通路相关的基因和蛋白表达。首先，用TGF-beta1处理人肝星状细胞系LX-2细胞以模拟纤维化发生。在活化的LX-2细胞暴露于3-HBI后，促纤维化物质的产生显著减少。分子对接研究显示，3-HBI对TGF-beta/SMAD2/3通路中的关键蛋白具有高结合亲和力。qRT-PCR和Western blotting分析表明，3-HBI抑制了TIMP1、MMP2、MMP9、COL1A1、COL4A1、SMAD2、SMAD3、SMAD4、MMP2和ACTA2的表达。综合这些发现，3-HBI抑制了LX-2细胞的活化，并显著减少了TGF-beta1触发的促炎反应。因此，我们确认了3-HBI作为预防和治疗肝纤维化治疗剂的显著潜力，其作用机制是通过调节TGF-beta/SMAD2/3信号通路实现的。
